regime: Silver under extra stress, miners lagging gold and a tech-led selloff, with bonds rallying
takeaway: Gold fell about 1% to near $4,025 while silver dropped about 3.1%, pushing the gold/silver ratio up to about 77, and gold miners fell about three times as much as gold. The Nasdaq lost 1.4% on Alphabet's slide and yields fell 8–9 basis points as money moved into bonds. Amazon and Intel fell sharply after hours, so Friday's open could look different.
